name: Kajabi
tagline: All-in-one platform for courses, communities, email, funnels, and payments

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Basic listed at $179/month monthly and $143/month annually.

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.limits: 5 products; 2,500 contacts; 1 website; 1 community; 2 admin users; 0 included AI credits.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.limits: 50 products; 25,000 contacts; 1 website; 1 community; 11 admin users; 500 AI credits.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.limits: Unlimited products; 100,000 contacts; 3 websites; 3 communities; 26 admin users; 1,000 AI credits.
tiers.notes: Annual price is $4,788; branded mobile app and public API are included.

pricing.hiddenCosts: Kajabi Payments rates are 2.9% + $0.30 / 2.8% + $0.30 / 2.7% + $0.30; third-party gateways add 2% / 1% / 0.5%. Basic/Growth pay $199/month for a branded app and $25/month for public API access; 500 AI-credit top-ups are $15; extra Backstage seats are listed at $20/seat/month on the detailed help page.

verdictSummary: You can build one course checkout or landing funnel, but Kajabi bundles site, course, community, email, automations, payments, analytics, and support.
coreLoopDIY: Build the specific funnel/course/membership needed with Stripe, a CMS, email provider, and gated content.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay to avoid stitching and maintaining a dozen creator-business tools.

priorArt.name: Moodle
priorArt.desc: Open-source LMS prior art; combine with email/commerce tools for partial Kajabi replacemen

alternatives.name: CourseLit
alternatives.desc: Courses, downloads, pages, email automation and paid communities in one self-hosted product; bookings remain elsewhere.

alternatives.name: systeme.io
alternatives.desc: One course, three funnels, email, a community and 2,000 contacts for free; enough for a small business, not a growing empire.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Ghost
rejectedAlternatives.desc: Publishing, email and memberships are covered; structured courses, quizzes and funnels are not.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Moodle
rejectedAlternatives.desc: An excellent LMS, but not the email, funnel, storefront and membership business Kajabi is bought to run.

notes: High price makes DIY attractive; all-in-one breadth makes full replacement hard.
prompt:
Build me a one-course sales-and-delivery site to replace Kajabi. Requirements:

- Node + Express + better-sqlite3 on my own VPS behind a reverse proxy. One product,
  one price, that is the scope.
- A server-rendered landing page: course pitch, curriculum list, and a Buy button
  that goes straight to Stripe Checkout (keys in .env).
- A Stripe webhook marks the buyer enrolled and emails a magic sign-in link via
  Resend or SMTP (creds in .env). No passwords, magic links only.
- Course content is a content/ folder of Markdown lessons with embedded video
  (self-hosted MP4 or unlisted Bunny/Vimeo links), rendered as an ordered lesson
  list with a per-student complete checkbox on each lesson.
- Students table in SQLite: email, purchase date, Stripe id, lessons completed.
- A small admin page on localhost only: enrollments, revenue total, and a button to
  comp someone free access.
- No telemetry, no third-party analytics; the only external services are Stripe and
  the email sender.
- Out of scope: email marketing automations, community features, funnels, and a
  multi-course catalog. One course, sold from one page.
- README: Stripe webhook setup, .env keys, and how to add a lesson.
